data.content:
I drafted and sent two of the three disputes. The third, UE-9b02, is weak and needs a ticket photo from you before I can draft it. The owner approvals went through for both sent disputes.

| Case | Amount | Evidence | Win chance | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| UE-9a47 (wrong item) | $11.80 | **Strong.** The ticket lists only a Protein Bowl, not the claimed Fruit Bowl. The order was picked up 2 minutes after it was ready. | 85% | Sent |
| UE-9a31 (missing item) | $24.30 | **Moderate.** The ticket lists the Honey Drizzle, and pickup was 5 minutes after the order was ready. | 75% | Sent |
| UE-9b02 (missing item) | $33.00 | **Weak.** No order ticket is on file, so I can't check the claimed Green Smoothie. | 30% | Not drafted |

- **UE-9a31:** The ticket shows the item was prepared, not that it was packed. The dispute doesn't claim anything about what was in the bag. My memory has no resolved Uber Eats cases to compare it with. Three DoorDash cases with the same evidence pattern gave two wins and one loss. The loss was a side item that wasn't itemised on the ticket, and the Honey Drizzle is itemised here.
- **UE-9a47:** The same applies. The ticket shows what was prepared, not what was packed, so the dispute makes no claim about the bag. There are no resolved similar Uber Eats cases to compare it with.
- **UE-9b02:** I didn't draft this one. It is the largest deduction, but with no ticket the evidence doesn't support a dispute. If you can send a photo of the order ticket, I'll re-check it. The win chance could go up, and then it would be worth drafting.

The next deadline is 2026-12-12, 28 days away. That applies to all three cases, including UE-9b02.

The case folder notes are in `/plan.md`. Tell me when the platform decides on either dispute and I'll record the outcome.
